name: foreverworks-esanatateamea
description: Read your Romanian health records: insurance, prescriptions, paid care, documents and appointments.

ESANATATEAMEA_USERNAME.title: eSănătateaMea e-mail
ESANATATEAMEA_USERNAME.description: The e-mail address you sign in to eSănătateaMea with; leave empty to sign in with ROeID instead.

ESANATATEAMEA_PASSWORD_FILE.title: eSănătateaMea password file
ESANATATEAMEA_PASSWORD_FILE.description: Path of a file holding only your eSănătateaMea password; leave empty to sign in with ROeID instead.

ESANATATEAMEA_TOTP_SECRET_FILE.title: Authenticator key file
ESANATATEAMEA_TOTP_SECRET_FILE.description: Path of a file holding the authenticator app's key for the account, so the server types the six-digit code itself; leave empty to be asked for the code.
